scope: WebArena GitLab CE 15.7.5 shared-runtime inference backend

components.name: postgresql
components.notes: Route freeze and HTTP drain precede clone operations.

components.name: gitaly
components.reset: replace routed repository tree from immutable reflink base
components.fork: reflink checkpoint repository tree into target branch
components.notes: GitLab 15.7.5 uses request-routed Gitaly relative paths and XFS reflink snapshots. Two-environment commit/checkpoint/fork/reset isolation and task 411 evaluator reward 1.0 are validated.

components.name: uploads
components.reset: replace routed upload tree from immutable reflink base
components.fork: reflink checkpoint upload tree into target branch
components.notes: GitLabUploader and subclass roots are request-routed to reflink branch trees. A two-environment real project-upload, fork, and reset smoke passes.

components.name: artifacts
components.reset: replace routed artifact tree from immutable reflink base
components.fork: reflink checkpoint artifact tree into target branch
components.notes: JobArtifactUploader is request-routed to a reflink branch tree. Two-environment write/read/fork/reset isolation passes.

components.name: redis
components.reset: delete branch state/cache prefixes and restore immutable base state
components.fork: restore authoritative key dump into child branch; start empty generation cache
components.notes: GitLab 15.7.5 SharedState, Sessions, TraceChunks, Cache, RateLimiting, and Rails cache consumers are routed through branch/generation namespaces. Concurrent namespace and reset/fork smoke passes.

components.name: sidekiq
components.reset: freeze HTTP, drain counted immediate jobs, remove routed scheduled jobs
components.fork: drain parent jobs before activating the child route
components.notes: Immediate jobs carry route claims, execute in the routed DB/Redis/Gitaly context, and are counted by the lifecycle/evaluator drain barrier. Two-environment worker and evaluator-drain smoke passes.

components.name: opensearch
components.notes: The exact WebArena GitLab CE 15.7.5 image has elasticsearch_search=false and elasticsearch_indexing=false. Shared mode fails boot if either is enabled; a future image with advanced search requires per-branch indexes and rebuilds.
